Merveilleuse expérience
Apr 2026 • Couples
We had a marvelous experience at this restaurant! After spending 104 days in Asia, it was a refreshing change of pace. The menu offers a great variety from their smokehouse. The owner is Canadian and has been living here for 18 years.
It’s perfect for families—besides the restaurant, there is a beautiful soccer field, a park, and a basketball court! It is also very well located, less than one kilometer from the cathedral. Beautiful spot, great food, and amazing vibes!

Pretty good
Nov 2025 • Couples
We visited Moose and Roo four times over a three week period. Meals were consistently good, obviously pricey for Vietnam. The only slight fail (other than the birthday parties that seem to be a feature) was the nachos. Large or small serving, the portions of meat and beans were negligible. Corn chips and cheese made up most of the meal. Desserts - fabulous, staff - lovely.

Once again an amazing lunch
Oct 2025 • Couples
Came here a few months ago with family and friends and was pretty impressed. Last Friday my wife and I had some things to do in Hanoi and when walking back we came face to face with ''The Moose & Roo'' (not them physically) but the Smokehouse and once again very impressed. The food was amazing, service was amazing and actually the price was not amazing but very reasonable for the quantity and quality of the meal we had. Will definitely be back and highly recommended if you in Hanoi and looking for western food, park / bar ambiance in central Hanoi and a friendly team

American-style food in a nice outdoor atmosphere
Jul 2025 • Business
The pictures here show it well: Your typical "american" food from chili hotdogs and Chicken wings to ribs, steaks and burgers. But: Not on the "ordinary" side but really well done with nice spices, rubs, marinades, etc. Really enjoyed the food.
It is on an outside patio (outside but you can also go if it's raining heavily because it's all under a large roof). Sportsbar atmosphere, very friendly service.
I discovered this last year when we here on vacation and was keen to visit again this year when I was here on business. Highly recommendable

Excellent once again
Mar 2025 • Family
Visited here many evenings whilst staying in Hanoi last month (March 2025).

We previously came 7 years ago and it's still amazing.

The food was delicious, hot and plentiful. Excellent choice on the menu and very reasonably priced.

Drinks very good and staff were super friendly, especially the young man with blonde hair, sorry I can't remember his name. The toilets very clean and a great play area outside for our 5 year old granddaughter.
We even purchased the Moo and Room T shirts and hoodies .
Thank you for a great few evenings.
